---
title: "Timeline"
---

```{r}
#| label: timeline-load
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)

if (!file.exists("data/processed/chapter_stats.csv")) {
  source("R/01_prepare_corpus.R")
}
if (!file.exists("data/processed/sentiment_by_chapter.csv")) {
  source("R/02_sentiment_analysis.R")
}

metadata <- read_csv("data/chapter_metadata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
stats <- read_csv("data/processed/chapter_stats.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
sentiment <- read_csv("data/processed/sentiment_by_chapter.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
years <- read_csv("data/processed/year_candidates_by_chapter.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
build_summary <- jsonlite::read_json("data/processed/build_summary.json")
```

This page uses the starter chapter metadata as a timeline scaffold. Treat these years as draft metadata until reviewed against the source text.

```{r}
#| echo: false
cat("**Source warning:** ", build_summary$source_warning)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
timeline <- metadata %>%
  filter(include_in_timeline == TRUE) %>%
  left_join(stats %>% select(chapter, word_count), by = "chapter") %>%
  left_join(sentiment %>% select(chapter, net_bing_sentiment, afinn_score), by = "chapter") %>%
  mutate(midpoint_year = (as.numeric(approx_start_year) + as.numeric(approx_end_year)) / 2)

timeline %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = midpoint_year, y = net_bing_sentiment, label = chapter)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(nudge_y = 5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Approximate midpoint year", y = "Net Bing sentiment", title = "Draft sentiment timeline") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Extracted year candidates

If this table is thin or empty, rebuild from raw `.rds` or scanned PDFs. The existing JSON source may have had numbers removed before export.

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(years) == 0) {
  cat("No year candidates found in the current text source.")
} else {
  DT::datatable(years, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
}
```
